what: head-rebuild study: the RefCOCO-family candidate-restriction stage re-measured from our own mechanisms as deterministic re-analysis over cached records (SAM ViT-H pool + cached G2L masked-region features + cached VLM boxes; no vision re-generation)

reference.name: reference: released-score top-15 restriction + box-fill pick (shipped head)
reference.role: the shipped RefCOCO-family head, reproduced bit-for-bit as deterministic re-analysis: candidate set = top-15 by rank01(sc) + 0.4906*rank01(gem) (released semantic + GEM), pick = argmax box-fill within

attrib_released_only.name: attribution: released-scores-only top-1 (no box, no restriction effect)
attrib_released_only.role: drop-the-box control: global argmax of the released fused key

attrib_box_full.name: attribution: box-fill pick over the FULL pool (no text restriction)
attrib_box_full.role: drop-the-restriction control: argmax box-fill over all SAM proposals

ours_region_text.name: ours: region-text top-15 restriction (fg @ full-sentence CLIP) + box-fill pick
ours_region_text.role: restriction rebuilt from our own protocol: top-15 by the cached masked-region feature against the FULL-sentence CLIP embedding (no released text ensemble, no GEM term), same box-fill pick

ours_key_only.name: attribution: our region-text key alone, top-1 (no box)
ours_key_only.role: drop-the-box control for the ours-only restriction stage

geom_guard.name: ours: geometric guards only (center-in-box, mask/box area <= 4) + box-fill pick
geom_guard.role: no text at all: guard-filter by mask centroid inside the box and mask-to-box area ratio <= 4, then argmax box-fill

geom_guard_strict.name: ours: strict geometric guards (center-in-box, mask/box area in [0.1, 2]) + box-fill pick
geom_guard_strict.role: no text at all: guard-filter by mask centroid inside the box and mask-to-box area ratio in [0.1, 2], then argmax box-fill

attrib_box_full_cover.name: attribution: box-fill pick (cover mode) over the FULL pool
attrib_box_full_cover.role: overlap-mode variant of the drop-the-restriction control (mask-covers-box fraction)

attrib_box_full_inside.name: attribution: box-fill pick (inside mode) over the FULL pool
attrib_box_full_inside.role: overlap-mode variant of the drop-the-restriction control (mask-inside-box fraction)

learned_geom2.name: ours: learned head over geometric terms only, richer set (no text, no features)
learned_geom2.role: HistGradientBoosting over box overlap (iou + cover), center-in-box, area ratio, mask area, centroid-to-box-center distance, box area, within-record rank, containment-parent; fitted on the held-out TRAIN tune refs only; uses neither released scores nor text

learned_geom.name: ours: learned head over geometric terms only (no text, no features)
learned_geom.role: HistGradientBoosting over box overlap, center-in-box, area ratio, mask area, within-record rank, containment-parent; fitted on the held-out TRAIN tune refs only; uses neither released scores nor text nor the masked-region features

learned_head.name: ours: learned head over our own per-proposal terms (HistGradientBoosting, declared trained)
learned_head.role: small head fitted on the RefCOCO-family held-out TRAIN tune refs only (1,137/1,120/765 records; target = proposal IoU >= 0.5); features are all ours: full-sentence region-text score, box overlap, center-in-box, area ratio, mask area, within-row ranks, containment-parent flag; val is a single frozen application
